questions.text: 'यह एक ऐसी पर्यावरण तैयार करने एवं उसे बनाए रखने की प्रक्रिया है जिसमें लोग समूह में कार्य करते हुए चयनित लक्ष्यों को कुशलता से प्राप्त करते हैं।' प्रक्रिया की पहचान कीजिए।
questions.text_english: 'It is the process of designing and maintaining an environment in which individuals, working together in groups, efficiently accomplish selected aims.' Identify the process.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Management. The definition given in the question — designing and maintaining an environment where individuals working in groups efficiently accomplish selected aims — is the classic definition of Management as given by Harold Koontz. Organising refers to structuring activities, Staffing deals with human resource procurement, and Directing involves guiding and leading employees. Only Management encompasses the entire process described.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) प्रबन्ध है। प्रश्न में दी गई परिभाषा — एक ऐसा वातावरण तैयार करना और बनाए रखना जिसमें लोग समूह में कार्य करते हुए लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करें — यह हेरोल्ड कून्ट्ज़ द्वारा दी गई प्रबन्ध की शास्त्रीय परिभाषा है।

questions.text: कवि 'स्टेशनरी मार्ट' में एक विपणन प्रबन्धक के रूप कार्य करता है। यह पूरे देश में बहुत से विद्यालयों के लिए विभिन्न प्रकार की स्टेशनरी मदों में लेन-देन करते हैं। जब विद्यालयों में नया सत्र आरम्भ होता है तो कवि प्रतिमाह प्रत्येक विद्यालय की विभिन्न स्टेशनरी उत्पादों की बिक्री का पूर्वानुमान लगाता है। सभी मदों को संख्याओं में प्रदर्शित किया जाता है ताकि उसे वास्तविक बिक्री की अनुमानित बिक्री से तुलना करना आसान हो जाए। उपरोक्त चर्चित योजना का प्रकार है:
questions.text_english: Kavi works as a Marketing Manager in stationery mart. It deals in various types of stationery items for many schools across the country. When new session starts in schools, Kavi forecasts the sales of different stationery products for each school for every month. All items are represented in numbers so that it becomes easier for him to compare the actual sales with expected sales. The type of plan discussed above is:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Budget. A budget is a plan that expresses expected results in numerical terms, such as sales forecasts in units or money. Since Kavi is forecasting sales of stationery items for each school every month and representing all items in numbers for comparison with actual sales, this is clearly a budget. A strategy is a long-term plan to achieve competitive advantage. A policy is a general guideline for decision-making. A programme is a detailed plan of activities. Only a budget involves numerical representation of future plans.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) बजट है। बजट एक ऐसी योजना है जो भावी परिणामों को संख्यात्मक रूप में व्यक्त करती है। कवि द्वारा मासिक बिक्री का पूर्वानुमान संख्याओं में करना और वास्तविक बिक्री से तुलना करना — यह बजट की परिभाषा से मेल खाता है।

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R):
अभिकथन (A): निर्देशन संगठन में आवश्यक परिवर्तनों को प्रारंभ करने में मदद करता है।
कारण (R): निर्देशन संगठन में परिवर्तनों के लिए प्रतिरोधों को बढ़ाता है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Given below are two statements, Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Directing facilitates introduction of needed changes in the organization.
Reason (R): Directing increases resistance to changes in the organization.
Choose the correct alternative from the alternatives given below:

options.A: दोनों अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही वर्णन है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।
options.D: दोनों अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) का सही वर्णन नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false. Assertion (A) is correct because directing helps managers guide, motivate and communicate changes to employees, thereby facilitating the introduction of necessary changes in the organization. However, Reason (R) is false because directing does not increase resistance to change; rather, through motivation, leadership, and communication, directing actually reduces resistance to change and helps employees accept and adapt to change willingly.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। अभिकथन (A) सत्य है क्योंकि निर्देशन प्रबन्धकों को संगठन में परिवर्तनों को लागू करने में मदद करता है। कारण (R) असत्य है क्योंकि निर्देशन परिवर्तनों के प्रति प्रतिरोध को बढ़ाता नहीं, बल्कि कम करता है।

questions.text: सीवीएक्स लिमिटेड एक अग्रणी कम्पनी थी जो घरेलू उपकरणों जैसे फूड प्रोसेसर, जूसर व मिक्सर ग्राइंडर का उत्पादन करती थी। कम्पनी अच्छे लाभ अर्जित कर रही थी और लगातार अपने अंशधारियों को उच्च लाभांश दे रही थी। कम्पनी ने अब सूप बनाने वाली मशीनों, पॉप-अप-टोस्टर्स तथा इलेक्ट्रिक आयरन के उत्पादन का निर्णय लिया। कम्पनी भारत के बाहर उभरते बाज़ारों में भी प्रवेश करना चाहती थी। नए बाज़ारों में प्रवेश के लिए कम्पनी को अतिरिक्त पूँजी निवेश की आवश्यकता होगी जो उत्पादन एवं वितरण के बुनियादी ढाँचे आदि को सुविधाजनक बनाएगी। इसके लिए प्रबन्धन ने आवश्यक निवेश के वित्तीयन के लिए अपने उपार्जन में से राशि को प्रतिधारित करने तथा अंशधारियों को कम लाभांश वितरित करने का निर्णय लिया। उभरते बाज़ारों में प्रवेश तथा नए उत्पादों को बाज़ारों में उतारने के लिए सीवीएक्स लिमिटेड द्वारा लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले जिस घटक को ध्यान में रखा गया, वह था:
questions.text_english: CVX Ltd. was a leading company, manufacturing home appliances like food processors, juicers and mixer grinders. The company was earning good profits and was paying high dividends to its shareholders consistently. The company now decided to manufacture soup-making machines, pop-up toasters and electric irons. The company wanted to enter into emerging markets out of India also. Entering these markets will require additional capital investment which will facilitate in production and distribution infrastructure etc. For this, the management decided to retain money out of their earnings to finance the required investment and distribute smaller dividend to the shareholders. The factor affecting dividend decision which was kept in mind by the management of CVX Ltd. for entering into emerging markets and launching new products was:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Growth Opportunities. CVX Ltd. retained its earnings and reduced dividend payments specifically to fund expansion into emerging markets and launch new products. This reflects the factor of 'Growth Opportunities' — when a company has high growth prospects, it tends to retain more profits to reinvest in the business rather than distributing them as dividends. The Amount of Earnings relates to how much profit is available, Stability of Earnings relates to consistent profits, and Stability of Dividends relates to maintaining regular payouts — none of these directly explain why dividends were cut for future expansion.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) संवृद्धि सुयोग है। कम्पनी ने भविष्य में विस्तार और नए उत्पाद लॉन्च के लिए कमाई को प्रतिधारित किया। यह संवृद्धि सुयोग कारक को दर्शाता है जिसमें कम्पनी लाभांश कम करके विकास में निवेश करती है।

questions.text:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों को सावधानीपूर्वक पढ़िए:
कथन-I: नियुक्तिकरण प्रबंध प्रक्रिया का वह भाग है जो संतुष्ट एवं संतुष्ट करने वाले कार्यबल के प्राप्तिकरण, उपयोग एवं रखरखाव से सम्बन्धित है।
कथन-II: नियुक्तिकरण एक निरंतर चलने वाली प्रक्रिया है।
दिए गए कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement-I: Staffing is that part of the process of management which is concerned with obtaining, utilizing and maintaining a satisfied and satisfactory workforce.
Statement-II: Staffing is a continuous process.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.C: कथन I सत्य है, परन्तु कथन II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन II सत्य है, परन्तु कथन I असत्य है।

options_english.C: Statement I is true, but Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement II is true, but Statement I is false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both the Statements are true. Statement I is true because Staffing is indeed concerned with obtaining (recruitment and selection), utilizing (placement and training), and maintaining (performance appraisal and compensation) a satisfied workforce. Statement II is also true because Staffing is a continuous process — as employees retire, resign, or new vacancies arise, the organization must continuously recruit, train, and retain staff. Hence both statements are correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है — दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। नियुक्तिकरण प्रबन्ध का वह भाग है जो कार्यबल की प्राप्ति, उपयोग और रखरखाव से संबंधित है, और यह एक निरंतर चलने वाली प्रक्रिया भी है।

questions.text: उस कथन का चयन कीजिए जो भर्ती के आन्तरिक स्रोतों का उपयोग करने के लाभ पर सही तरीके से प्रकाश डालता है।
questions.text_english: Choose the statement that correctly highlights the benefit of using internal sources of recruitment.

options.A: यह चयन की प्रक्रिया को सरल बनाने में सहायता करता है।
options.B: कर्मचारियों के चयन के समय यह वृहद विकल्प प्रदान करता है।
options.C: यह संगठन में नया खून/प्रतिभा लाता है।
options.D: यह एक महंगा एवं अधिक समय लेने वाला स्रोत है।

options_english.A: It helps in simplifying the process of selection.
options_english.B: It provides wider choice while selecting the employees.
options_english.C: It brings new blood in the organization.
options_english.D: It is an expensive and time consuming source.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) It helps in simplifying the process of selection. When candidates are recruited from internal sources (promotion, transfer), their performance records, abilities, and conduct are already known to the organization, which makes the selection process simpler and less time-consuming. Option (B) is a benefit of external sources as they provide a wider pool. Option (C) — bringing new talent — is also an advantage of external sources, not internal. Option (D) is actually a limitation of external recruitment, not a benefit of internal recruitment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। आंतरिक स्रोतों से भर्ती करने पर उम्मीदवारों के बारे में पहले से जानकारी होती है, जिससे चयन प्रक्रिया सरल हो जाती है। विकल्प (B) और (C) बाह्य स्रोतों के लाभ हैं, और (D) बाह्य स्रोतों की सीमा है।

questions.text: अतुल बने बनाए कपड़ों की एक फैक्ट्री में एक कर्मचारी के रूप में कार्य कर रहा था। वह बहुत ईमानदार और समर्पित था तथा अपने कार्य को हमेशा समय पर पूरा करता था। उसे यह देखकर बहुत पीड़ा होती थी कि काम करने की योग्यता के बावजूद भी उसके साथी काम करने में अनिच्छुक थे। उसके अच्छे व्यवहार तथा कार्य करने की इच्छा के कारण उसको उसी समूह के पर्यवेक्षक के रूप में पदोन्नत कर दिया गया जिसमें पहले वह एक कामगार था। वह यह भली-भाँति समझता था कि केवल औपचारिक अधिकारों का प्रयोग करके कर्मचारियों से बेहतरीन कार्य लेना सदैव संभव नहीं था। उसमें लोगों के व्यवहार के कारणों को जानने की अन्तर्दृष्टि थी। वह जानता था कि संगठनिक उद्देश्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए कामगारों से इच्छित ढंग से कैसे कार्य करवाया जाता है। उसके पर्यवेक्षण के अन्तर्गत उन कामगारों ने भी कुशलतापूर्वक एवं प्रभावपूर्ण ढंग से कार्य करना आरंभ कर दिया जो कार्य करने में अनिच्छुक थे। निम्नलिखित में से उस अवधारणा की पहचान कीजिए जिसका प्रयोग अतुल द्वारा एक पर्यवेक्षक के रूप में कार्य पूर्ण कराने के लिए किया गया:
questions.text_english: Atul was working as an employee in a readymade garments factory. He was very sincere and dedicated and always completed his work in time. It pained him to see that his colleagues were reluctant to do the work even though they had the ability to do it. Due to his good behaviour and willingness to work, he was promoted to the post of the supervisor of the same team in which he was a worker earlier. He understood very well that it was not always possible to get the best of work from employees merely by exercising formal authority. He had insights into the causes of behaviour of people. He knew how to get the work done by the workers in a desired manner to achieve the organizational objectives. Under his supervision even the workers who were reluctant to work started working efficiently and effectively. From the following, identify the concept used by Atul, as a supervisor to get the work completed:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Leadership. Atul used leadership — the ability to influence people to work willingly towards organizational goals without relying solely on formal authority. He had insights into human behaviour, knew how to get work done in a desired manner, and inspired even reluctant workers to perform efficiently. This matches the definition of leadership perfectly. Motivation is broader and relates to internal drives; financial and non-financial incentives are tools used to motivate, but the overarching concept of influencing others through personal qualities is Leadership.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) नेतृत्व है। अतुल ने औपचारिक अधिकार के बजाय अपनी व्यक्तिगत प्रतिभा और अंतर्दृष्टि से कर्मचारियों को प्रभावित किया और उन्हें कार्य करने के लिए प्रेरित किया — यह नेतृत्व का लक्षण है।

questions.text: ईशा शर्मा ने जैविक, शाकाहारी तथा स्वास्थ्यवर्धक मिठाईयों के विकल्प, जैसे हेजलनट्स खजूर के लड्डू, सूखे मेवे और खजूर से बनी बर्फी, भरवाँ मेजडूल खजूर आदि बनाने व बेचने के लिए 'ईशा स्वीट्स' की स्थापना की। पिछले कुछ वर्षों से उसके उत्पादों की माँग बहुत अधिक थी क्योंकि आजकल लोग उपभोग तथा साथ ही उपहार देने के लिए स्वास्थ्यवर्धक विकल्प क्रय करना पसंद करते हैं। लेकिन इस वर्ष अचानक इन मिठाईयों को तैयार करने में प्रयोग किए जाने वाले खजूर, सूखे मेवों तथा अन्य सामग्रियों का मूल्य बढ़ गया। कच्चे माल के बढ़ते हुए मूल्यों के साथ उत्पादन तथा बिक्री की स्थिर मात्रा को बनाए रखने के लिए अधिक मात्रा में कोषों की आवश्यकता थी। परिणामस्वरूप 'ईशा स्वीट्स' की कार्यशील पूँजी की आवश्यकताएँ अधिक हो गई। 'ईशा स्वीट्स' की कार्यशील पूँजी आवश्यकताओं की वृद्धि जिस कारक के कारण हुई, वह था:
questions.text_english: 'Isha Sweets' was set by Isha Sharma to prepare and sell organic, vegan and healthy sweets alternatives like hazelnuts date ladoos, dry fruit date burfi, stuffed mejdool date etc. For the last many years, the demand for her products was very high as people these days prefer to buy healthier alternatives for consumption as well as gifting purposes. But this year suddenly, the cost of dates, dry fruits and other ingredients used for preparing these healthy sweets had increased. With rising prices of raw materials, larger amounts of funds were required to maintain a constant volume of production and sales. As a result, the working capital requirement of 'Isha Sweets' became higher. The factor which led to an increase in the working capital requirements of 'Isha Sweets' was:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Inflation. The case clearly states that the prices of raw materials like dates and dry fruits rose suddenly, requiring more funds to maintain the same level of production and sales. This is the effect of inflation — rising price levels increase the working capital requirements of a business because more money is needed to purchase the same quantity of inputs. Availability of raw material relates to supply disruptions, scale of business affects working capital through volume, and production cycle length affects how long money is tied up in production.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) मुद्रास्फीति है। कच्चे माल की कीमतें बढ़ने के कारण उत्पादन की समान मात्रा बनाए रखने के लिए अधिक धन की आवश्यकता पड़ी — यह मुद्रास्फीति का प्रभाव है जो कार्यशील पूँजी की जरूरत बढ़ाता है।

questions.text: 'संगठन प्रक्रिया व्यावसायिक इकाइयों को व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण परिवर्तनों में समायोजित होने की अनुमति प्रदान करती है। यह संगठन संरचना में प्रबन्धकीय स्तर का उपयुक्त परिवर्तन तथा आपसी सम्बन्धों के संशोधनों में पारगमन का मार्ग प्रशस्त करता है।' उपरोक्त पंक्तियों में प्रबन्ध के संगठन कार्य के महत्व के जिस बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है:
questions.text_english: 'The process of organizing allows a business enterprise to accommodate changes in the business environment. It allows the organization structure to be suitably modified to pave the way for a smooth transition.' The point of importance of organizing function of management highlighted in the above lines is:

options.B: कार्य करने में सम्बन्धों की स्पष्टीकरण

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Adaptation to change. The given lines explicitly state that organizing allows a business to accommodate changes in the business environment and to suitably modify the organizational structure for a smooth transition. This directly points to the importance of organizing in helping an enterprise adapt to changing conditions. Benefits of specialization relate to division of work, clarity in working relationships refers to defined authority and responsibility, and optimum utilization refers to efficient use of resources — none of these are described in the quoted lines.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) परिवर्तनों का अनुकूलन है। उद्धृत पंक्तियाँ स्पष्ट रूप से बताती हैं कि संगठन कार्य व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण में परिवर्तनों के अनुसार संरचना को संशोधित करने में सहायक है।

questions.text: एक क्रेता किसी वस्तु अथवा सेवा का क्रय इसलिए करता है कि यह उसके लिए कितनी उपयोगी है अथवा यह उसे कितना लाभ पहुँचाती है। एक उत्पाद के क्रय से एक उपभोक्ता तीन प्रकार के लाभ प्राप्त कर सकता है: (i) कार्यात्मक लाभ, (ii) सामाजिक लाभ और (iii)…………
questions.text_english: A buyer buys a product or service for what it does for him / her or the benefit it provides to him / her. There can be three type of benefits, a consumer may seek to satisfy from the purchase of a product: (i) Functional benefits, (ii) Social benefits and (iii)……………………
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Psychological benefits. According to the concept of product in marketing, a consumer buys a product for three types of benefits — functional (what the product physically does), social (status and recognition from peers), and psychological (emotional satisfaction, feeling of security, pride, or pleasure). Technological, economic, and environmental are not standard categories in the classification of consumer benefits from a product purchase.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) मनोवैज्ञानिक लाभ है। विपणन के अनुसार, उत्पाद से तीन प्रकार के लाभ होते हैं — कार्यात्मक, सामाजिक और मनोवैज्ञानिक। मनोवैज्ञानिक लाभ में भावनात्मक संतुष्टि, गर्व आदि शामिल हैं।

questions.text: निमेष एच.एल. लिमिटेड में एक उत्पादन प्रबन्धक के रूप में कार्य कर रहा था, जो एक इलेक्ट्रिकल तार बनाने वाली कम्पनी है। एक विक्रेता जो एच.एल. लिमिटेड को ताँबे की आपूर्ति करता था, 15 दिन के अन्दर अपना व्यवसाय बंद करना चाहता था क्योंकि उसे अपने बेटे के पास विदेश जाना था। विक्रेता अपना सारा स्टॉक 60% छूट पर बेच रहा था। निमेष ने इस सामग्री को खरीदने की मंजूरी प्राप्त करने के लिए महाप्रबंधक को एक पत्र लिखा। लेकिन कठोर नियमों तथा जटिल प्रक्रिया के कारण मंजूरी प्राप्त करने में देरी हो गई और ऑर्डर नहीं दिया जा सका। सम्प्रेषण की वह बाधा जिसके कारण प्रक्रिया में देरी हुई, वह थी:
questions.text_english: Nimesh was working as a Production Manager in H.L. Ltd., an electrical wire manufacturing company. One of the vendors who was supplying copper to H.L. Ltd. wanted to close down his business within 15 days as he had to go abroad to live with his son. The vendor was selling all his stocks at 60% discount. Nimesh wrote a letter to the General Manager to seek approval for procurement of this material. But due to rigid rules and cumbersome procedures there was delay in getting sanction and order could not be placed. The type of communication barrier that led to procedural delay was:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Organizational barrier. The delay in getting sanction was caused by rigid rules and cumbersome procedures within the organization. These are organizational barriers to communication, which arise due to strict rules, lengthy approval processes, hierarchical structures, and complex procedures that slow down the flow of information and decision-making. Semantic barriers arise from language and meaning issues; psychological barriers relate to emotions and attitudes; and personal barriers relate to interpersonal issues between individuals.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) संगठनिक बाधा है। कठोर नियमों और जटिल प्रक्रियाओं के कारण देरी हुई — यह संगठनिक बाधा का उदाहरण है जो संगठन की संरचना और नियमों से उत्पन्न होती है।

questions.text: एक व्यक्ति का अपने अधीनस्थों को आदेश देने तथा अपने पद की सीमा के अंतर्गत कार्यवाही करने का अधिकार कहलाता है:
questions.text_english: 'The right of an individual to command his subordinates and to take action within the scope of his position' is called:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Authority. Authority is defined as the right of a manager to command subordinates and take actions within the scope of his position to achieve organizational goals. Decentralization refers to the distribution of authority across multiple levels. Responsibility is the obligation to perform the assigned task. Accountability means being answerable for the outcome of one's actions. The definition in the question — the right to command and act within position's scope — precisely matches Authority.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) अधिकार है। अधिकार वह अधिकार है जिससे प्रबन्धक अपने अधीनस्थों को आदेश दे सकता है और अपने पद की सीमा के भीतर कार्य कर सकता है।

questions.text: उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम, 2019 के अनुसार निम्न में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
questions.text_english: As per the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 which of the following statement is correct?

options.A: यदि असंतुष्ट पक्ष जिला आयोग के आदेश से संतुष्ट नहीं है तो वह सीधे राष्ट्रीय आयोग में अपील कर सकता है।
options.B: यदि असंतुष्ट पक्ष जिला आयोग के आदेश से संतुष्ट नहीं है तो वह सीधे सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में अपील कर सकता है।
options.C: यदि असंतुष्ट पक्ष राज्य आयोग के आदेश से संतुष्ट नहीं है तो वह सीधे सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में अपील कर सकता है।
options.D: यदि असंतुष्ट पक्ष राष्ट्रीय आयोग के आदेश से संतुष्ट नहीं है तो वह सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में अपील कर सकता है।

options_english.A: In case the aggrieved party is not satisfied with the order of the District Commission, he can directly appeal before the National Commission.
options_english.B: In case the aggrieved party is not satisfied with the order of the District Commission, he can directly appeal before the Supreme Court.
options_english.C: In case the aggrieved party is not satisfied with the order of the State Commission, he can directly appeal before the Supreme Court.
options_english.D: In case the aggrieved party is not satisfied with the order of the National Commission, he can appeal before the Supreme Court.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the three-tier redressal mechanism works as follows: appeals against District Commission orders go to the State Commission; appeals against State Commission orders go to the National Commission; and appeals against National Commission orders go to the Supreme Court. Option (A) is wrong because appeals from the District Commission go to the State Commission, not directly to the National Commission. Options (B) and (C) are also wrong for similar reasons. Only option (D) correctly states that an appeal against the National Commission's order lies before the Supreme Court.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम 2019 के अनुसार, राष्ट्रीय आयोग के आदेश से असंतुष्ट पक्ष सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में अपील कर सकता है। यही तीन-स्तरीय तंत्र की सर्वोच्च अपीलीय प्रक्रिया है।

questions.text: दिए गए चित्र में वर्णित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के आयाम को पहचानिए।
questions.text_english: Identify the dimension of business environment illustrated by the given picture.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Technological. The image shows an AI-powered robot acting as a news anchor, which represents the impact of Artificial Intelligence technology on the business and media environment. This clearly depicts the Technological dimension of the business environment, which refers to changes and advancements in technology that affect business operations and the nature of products and services offered. Social dimension relates to cultural and social trends, political to government policies, and economic to income and financial conditions.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) प्रौद्योगिकीय है। चित्र में एक AI रोबोट समाचार वाचक के रूप में कार्य कर रहा है, जो व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के प्रौद्योगिकीय आयाम को दर्शाता है।

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R):
अभिकथन (A): नियोजन में दूरदर्शिता तथा भविष्य के लिए तैयारी सम्मिलित है।
कारण (R): नियोजन का उद्देश्य किसी संगठन के सर्वोत्तम लाभ के लिए भविष्य की घटनाओं का प्रभावी ढंग से सामना करना है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Given below are two statements, Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Planning involves looking ahead and preparing for the future.
Reason (R): The purpose of planning is to meet future events effectively to the best advantage of an organization.
Choose the correct alternative from the alternatives given below:

options.A: दोनों अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: दोनों अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion (A) is correct because planning is essentially a forward-looking activity that involves anticipating the future and preparing for it. Reason (R) is also correct and it directly explains why planning involves looking ahead — because the very purpose of planning is to meet future events effectively for the organization's maximum benefit. The reason explains the 'why' behind the assertion, making (A) the right choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन (A) सत्य है क्योंकि नियोजन भविष्य को देखकर तैयारी करने की प्रक्रिया है। कारण (R) भी सत्य है और यह अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है — नियोजन इसलिए किया जाता है ताकि भविष्य की घटनाओं का सर्वोत्तम ढंग से सामना किया जा सके।

questions.text: कॉलम-I में दी गई वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्ध की तकनीकों का कॉलम-II में दिए गए उनके अर्थ से मिलान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Match the techniques of scientific management given in Column-I with their meaning given in Column-II:
questions.instruction_line: कॉलम-I: (a) कार्यपद्धति अध्ययन, (b) गति अध्ययन, (c) समय अध्ययन, (d) थकान अध्ययन. कॉलम-II: (i) विभिन्न मुद्राओं के अध्ययन, (ii) आराम के अंतराल, (iii) मानक समय, (iv) सर्वश्रेष्ठ पद्धति
questions.instruction_line_english: Column-I: (a) Method Study, (b) Motion Study, (c) Time Study, (d) Fatigue Study. Column-II: (i) Study of movements, (ii) Rest intervals, (iii) Standard time, (iv) Best way of doing a job
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C): (a)-(iv), (b)-(i), (c)-(iii), (d)-(ii). Method Study (a) aims at finding the one best way of doing a job (iv). Motion Study (b) involves the study of movements like lifting, putting objects, sitting and changing positions undertaken while doing a job (i). Time Study (c) determines the standard time taken to perform a well-defined task (iii). Fatigue Study (d) determines the amount and frequency of rest intervals needed to maintain worker efficiency (ii).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: (a)-(iv), (b)-(i), (c)-(iii), (d)-(ii)। कार्यपद्धति अध्ययन — सर्वश्रेष्ठ पद्धति; गति अध्ययन — विभिन्न मुद्राओं का अध्ययन; समय अध्ययन — मानक समय निर्धारण; थकान अध्ययन — आराम के अंतराल का निर्धारण।

questions.text: अक्षरा अपने शहर के एक प्रसिद्ध क्षेत्र में 'ए.के. सोल्यूशन्स' नाम से व्यवसाय चला रही है, जहाँ लोग विद्यार्थियों को लाइब्रेरी के रूप में, पढ़ाई केन्द्रों के रूप में तथा व्यवसायों के लिए प्रशिक्षण एवं ईवेंट सेंटर स्थान प्रदान करते हैं। अक्षरा बड़े एवं छोटे उद्यमों को उनकी बैठकों एवं कार्यक्रमों के लिए केवल सम्मेलन कक्ष प्रदान करती है। जुलाई 2024 में अचानक बाढ़ से उसके पड़ोसी क्षेत्र में कुछ लाइब्रेरी तथा पढ़ाई केन्द्र प्रभावित हो गए। परीक्षाएँ बहुत तेजी से पास आ रही थीं और विद्यार्थियों को बहुत सी समस्याओं का सामना करना पड़ रहा था क्योंकि इन पढ़ाई केन्द्रों तथा लाइब्रेरियों को बंद करना पड़ा। इस सुअवसर का लाभ उठाते हुए तथा विद्यार्थियों की सहायता करने के लिए 'ए.के.सोल्यूशन्स' ने स्वयं को पर्यावरण की आवश्यकताओं के अनुरूप बनाया। उन्होंने अपने कुछ सम्मेलन कक्षों को लाइब्रेरी एवं पढ़ाई केन्द्रों में परिवर्तित करने का निर्णय लिया। उन्होंने विद्यार्थियों के लिए आवश्यक अन्य सुविधाओं एवं खाने को भी कम मूल्य पर प्रदान करने का निर्णय लिया। इस पहल से उनका व्यवसाय कई गुना बढ़ गया तथा उन्होंने महत्वपूर्ण ख्याति अर्जित की। उपरोक्त स्थिति में प्रबन्ध की जिस विशेषता पर प्रभाव डाला गया है, वह है:
questions.text_english: Akshara runs a business in the name of 'AK Solutions' in a well reputed area of her city where people provide spaces to students as library, as study centres and as training and event centres to businesses. Akshara provides only conference halls to big and small enterprises for their meetings and events. Suddenly, in July 2024, floods affected some libraries and study centres in her neighbouring area. The exams were fast approaching and students were facing a lot of problems as these study centres and libraries had to be closed. Taking advantage of this opportunity and to help the students 'AK Solutions' adapted itself to the needs of the environment, they decided to convert some of their conference halls into libraries and study centres. They also decided to provide food and other facilities required by the students at subsidized rates. This initiative increased their business manifold and earned them significant goodwill. The feature of management highlighted in the above case is:

options.A: प्रबन्ध एक निरन्तर चलने वाली प्रक्रिया है।

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Management is a dynamic function. AK Solutions quickly adapted its business model from conference halls to libraries and study centres in response to a sudden change in the environment (flood affecting neighbouring libraries). This ability to change, adapt, and respond to the changing business environment demonstrates that management is a dynamic function. It does not remain static; it continuously changes its goals, strategies, and methods according to the environment. The other options do not capture the essence of this adaptive response to environmental change.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है — प्रबन्ध एक गतिशील कार्य है। अक्षरा ने पर्यावरण की बदलती जरूरतों के अनुसार अपने व्यवसाय को बदल दिया, जो प्रबन्ध की गतिशील प्रकृति को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: 'ब्याज की उपस्थिति जैसे स्थायी वित्तीय प्रभारों के कारण समता अंशधारियों के अर्जित लाभ में वृद्धि' कहलाती है:
questions.text_english: 'Increase in the profit earned by the equity shareholders due to the presence of fixed financial charges like interest' is called:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Trading on equity. Trading on equity refers to the practice of using borrowed capital (debt) that carries a fixed interest charge to enhance the returns (earnings per share) of equity shareholders. When a company earns more on its borrowed funds than the interest it pays on them, the surplus increases the profit available to equity shareholders, thus boosting their returns. Financial planning involves estimating future financial needs, dividend decision concerns distribution of profits, and financing decision relates to the mix of debt and equity — none of these describe the specific concept of leveraging debt to increase equity returns.

नीचे दिए गए कथनों को सावधानीपूर्वक पढ़िए:
कथन-I: ऋण की लागत समता की लागत से अधिक है।
कथन-II: समता अंशधारियों के जोखिम की अपेक्षा ऋणदाताओं का जोखिम कम होता है।
दिए गए कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement-I: The cost of debt is more than the cost of equity.
Statement-II: Lenders risk is lower than the equity shareholders risk.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.C: कथन-I सत्य है, कथन-II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन-II सत्य है, कथन-I असत्य है।

options_english.C: Statement I is true, Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement I is false, Statement II is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) — Statement I is false, Statement II is true. Statement I is false because the cost of debt is actually less than the cost of equity. Debt is cheaper because interest on debt is a tax-deductible expense and lenders bear less risk than equity shareholders. Statement II is true because lenders (debt holders) have a prior claim on the company's assets and earnings over equity shareholders, so their risk is indeed lower. Equity shareholders bear the residual risk as they are paid only after all other obligations are met.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। कथन-I असत्य है क्योंकि ऋण की लागत समता से कम होती है (ब्याज कर-कटौती योग्य है)। कथन-II सत्य है क्योंकि ऋणदाताओं का जोखिम समता अंशधारियों से कम होता है।

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Financial Planning. Capital structure refers to the mix of debt and equity used. Financial leverage refers to using fixed-cost financing to magnify returns. Investment decision relates to how funds are deployed in long-term assets. The definition of ensuring funds availability at the right time directly matches Financial Planning.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following functions of Stock Exchange: (i) Providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities, (ii) Pricing of securities, (iii) Safety of transaction

key_points: Liquidity and marketability — investors can buy/sell readily
Pricing through demand and supply forces
Safety through SEBI regulation and standardized trading rules

sub_questions.solution: Stock exchanges perform three vital functions. First, by providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities, the stock exchange gives investors a ready platform to convert their shares and debentures into cash at any time. This makes securities attractive because investors know they can exit their investments when needed. Second, in terms of pricing of securities, the stock exchange acts as a platform where prices are determined by the forces of demand and supply. The continuous trading activity reflects the real worth of securities based on the company's performance, future prospects, and market sentiment, thus arriving at a fair price. Third, regarding safety of transactions, the stock exchange operates under the strict regulation of SEBI and follows well-defined rules and procedures. All listed companies must comply with disclosure norms, and transactions are conducted through registered brokers, which protects investors from fraudulent deals and ensures transparency.

sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Primary Market' and 'Secondary Market' on the basis of any three points.

key_points: Meaning — new vs existing securities
Participants — companies vs investors
Price determination — fixed vs market-driven

sub_questions.solution: The Primary Market and Secondary Market differ on three key points. First, with respect to meaning and purpose, the primary market (also called the new issue market) deals with the issue of new securities by companies for the first time to raise fresh capital directly from investors. The secondary market (stock exchange) deals with the buying and selling of existing or already issued securities among investors. Second, regarding the flow of funds, in the primary market, funds flow from investors directly to the company issuing the securities, helping the company raise capital for expansion or new projects. In the secondary market, funds flow from one investor to another and the company receives no new funds. Third, concerning price determination, in the primary market the price of securities is fixed by the company (in case of a fixed price issue) or determined through book building. In the secondary market, prices fluctuate continuously based on the forces of demand and supply in the open market.

sub_questions.text_english: Give the meaning of 'Capital Market'. Differentiate between 'Capital Market' and 'Money Market' on the basis of: (i) Participants, (ii) Instruments

key_points: Capital Market meaning — long-term funds market
Participants — Capital Market vs Money Market
Instruments — Capital Market vs Money Market

sub_questions.solution: Capital Market refers to the market for long-term funds where securities with a maturity period of more than one year are traded. It includes both the primary market and the secondary market and deals in equity shares, debentures, bonds, and preference shares. Regarding participants, the Capital Market is open to a wider range of participants including retail investors, insurance companies, mutual funds, foreign institutional investors, and commercial banks. In contrast, the Money Market is restricted to participants such as the Reserve Bank of India, commercial banks, and other financial institutions dealing in short-term financial instruments. With respect to instruments, the Capital Market deals in long-term instruments like equity shares, preference shares, debentures, and bonds. The Money Market, on the other hand, deals in short-term instruments such as Treasury Bills, Commercial Paper, Certificate of Deposit, and Call Money.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three 'Regulatory functions' of Securities and Exchange Board of India.

key_points: Registration of market intermediaries
Regulation of takeovers and mergers
Prohibition of insider trading

sub_questions.solution: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) performs several regulatory functions to maintain order and fairness in the securities market. First, SEBI registers and regulates the working of stock brokers, sub-brokers, share transfer agents, merchant bankers, mutual funds, and all other market intermediaries. This ensures that only qualified and trustworthy entities operate in the capital market. Second, SEBI regulates mergers, amalgamations, and takeovers of companies to protect the interests of investors and ensure that such transactions are conducted in a fair and transparent manner. Third, SEBI prohibits fraudulent and unfair trade practices including insider trading — the use of unpublished price-sensitive information by company insiders for personal gain — to maintain integrity and investor confidence in the securities market.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following principles of management given by Fayol: (i) Division of work, (ii) Authority and Responsibility

key_points: Division of work — specialization leads to efficiency
Authority — right to give orders
Responsibility — obligation to perform
Balance between authority and responsibility

sub_questions.solution: Fayol's first principle, Division of Work, states that work should be divided among individuals and groups based on their abilities and specialization. When each worker specializes in a particular task, they develop expertise over time, which leads to greater efficiency, higher quality output, less wastage of time, and better overall productivity. For example, in a factory, one worker may specialize in assembling and another in quality checking rather than both performing all tasks. Fayol's second principle, Authority and Responsibility, states that authority is the right of a manager to give orders and get things done, while responsibility is the obligation to perform the assigned duties. Fayol emphasized that there must be a proper balance between authority and responsibility — if authority exceeds responsibility, a manager may misuse it, and if responsibility exceeds authority, the manager cannot function effectively. Both should go hand-in-hand for smooth management.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following points of significance of principles of management: (i) Providing managers with useful insights into reality. (ii) Optimum utilization of resources and effective administration.

key_points: Principles provide ready-made guidance based on experience
Managers can make better decisions using principles
Resources used efficiently by following scientific principles
Reduction in wastage and improved administration

sub_questions.solution: The first point of significance, providing managers with useful insights into reality, means that the principles of management are based on the observations, experiments, and practical experience of many managers over long periods of time. These principles act as a guiding framework that helps managers understand complex real-world situations more clearly. Instead of making decisions purely by trial and error, managers can use these time-tested principles as ready reference points to handle managerial problems effectively. For instance, the principle of Unity of Command helps a manager understand why employees become confused when they receive orders from multiple bosses. The second point, optimum utilization of resources and effective administration, means that when managers apply management principles scientifically, they are able to plan the allocation of resources — human, physical, and financial — more efficiently. This reduces wastage of time, money, and effort. Techniques like division of work, use of standard methods, and proper delegation help an organization achieve its goals with minimum resources and maximum output, thereby improving overall administrative effectiveness.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following features of co-ordination: (i) Co-ordination integrates group efforts. (ii) Co-ordination is the responsibility of all managers.

key_points: Co-ordination unifies diverse efforts toward a common goal
Every level of manager must coordinate — top, middle and supervisory

sub_questions.solution: The first feature, co-ordination integrates group efforts, means that co-ordination brings together the diverse and sometimes conflicting efforts of different departments, teams, and individuals in an organization and unifies them toward the achievement of a common goal. Without co-ordination, departments may work in isolation or at cross-purposes — for example, the production department may manufacture more goods than the marketing department can sell. Co-ordination ensures that all these separate activities are synchronized and directed toward organizational objectives, thereby converting individual efforts into collective achievement. The second feature, co-ordination is the responsibility of all managers, means that coordination is not the exclusive duty of top-level management alone. Managers at all levels — top, middle, and supervisory — must ensure co-ordination in their respective areas of work. Top managers coordinate the activities of different departments, middle-level managers coordinate the work of their supervisors and teams, and supervisory managers coordinate the day-to-day work of workers. Thus, co-ordination is a pervasive function that every manager must perform regardless of their level in the organizational hierarchy.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following features of management: (i) Management is a goal-oriented process. (ii) Management is a continuous process.

key_points: Goal-oriented — management exists to achieve specific objectives
Continuous — management functions are performed repeatedly and without interruption

sub_questions.solution: The first feature, management is a goal-oriented process, means that management does not exist for its own sake but is always directed towards the achievement of specific, pre-determined goals. These goals may be economic (like earning profit), social (like providing employment), or personal (like meeting the individual aspirations of employees). All managerial activities — planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling — are undertaken with the sole purpose of attaining these objectives. Without a clear goal, management has no direction or purpose. The second feature, management is a continuous process, means that management is not a one-time activity but an ongoing and never-ending process. The functions of management — planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling — are performed continuously and repeatedly throughout the life of the organization. Even when one plan is successfully implemented, new plans must be made for the future. Managers must continuously monitor performance, take corrective action, and prepare for fresh challenges. This continuity ensures that the organization remains functional and goal-directed at all times.

निशा ने अपनी कुछ पुरानी पोशाकें घर की मदद करने वाली बीनू को दीं। कुछ दिनों बाद निशा खुशी से आश्चर्यचकित हो गयी जब उसने उन्हीं पोशाकों में से एक को सुन्दर ढंग से ठीक करके नए जैसा बनाकर बीनू को पहने हुए देखा। पूछताछ करने पर बीनू ने उसे बताया कि यह उसकी बेटी ने किया है, जिसने अभी-अभी कक्षा 12 की पढ़ाई पूरी की है। बीनू ने निशा को यह भी बताया कि वह कुछ चिन्तित है क्योंकि उसकी बेटी आगे पढ़ना नहीं चाहती थी। निशा बीनू की बेटी की सृजनात्मकता से बहुत अधिक प्रभावित थी, अत: उसने उसके लिए एक छोटा सा व्यवसाय स्थापित करने का निर्णय लिया। निशा ने 15 सिलाई मशीनें खरीदीं और पुरानी पोशाकों को ठीक करके नए जैसा बनाने के लिए 15 लड़कियों को नियुक्त किया। निशा ने विभिन्न स्रोतों से पुरानी पोशाकों की व्यवस्था की और एक व्यक्ति को नियुक्त किया जो इन पोशाकों को बहुत कम कीमत पर उन लोगों को बेचेगा जो अपनी कम आय के कारण नई पोशाकें नहीं खरीद सकते। निशा ने लड़कियों को तीन समूहों में बाँट दिया, प्रत्येक समूह के पास पाँच सिलाई मशीनें थीं। प्रत्येक समूह को 15 दिन के अन्दर 150 पुरानी पोशाकों को ₹ 30 प्रति पोशाक की लागत पर ठीक करके नए जैसा बनाना था। 15 दिन के बाद, निशा को जो बीनू के साथ व्यवसाय का पर्यवेक्षण कर रही थी, सूचित किया गया कि समूह-I ने 150 पुरानी पोशाकों को ₹ 30 प्रति पोशाक की दर से ठीक करके नए जैसा बनाकर लक्ष्य की प्राप्ति कर ली। समूह-II 150 पुरानी पोशाकों को ₹ 35 प्रति पोशाक की दर से ठीक करके नए जैसा बना सका जबकि समूह-III केवल 140 पुरानी पोशाकों को ठीक करके नए जैसा बना सका लेकिन ₹ 27 प्रति पोशाक की लागत पर।
(i) अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में कारण देते हुए उपरोक्त तीनों समूहों में से प्रत्येक समूह में चर्चित प्रबन्ध की अवधारणाओं को पहचानिए।
(ii) उपरोक्त (i) में पहचानी गई अवधारणाओं का अर्थ दीजिए और उल्लेख कीजिए कि कौन सी अवधारणा प्रबन्ध के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है और क्यों?
questions.text_english:
Nisha had given some old dresses of her own to her house-helper Beenu. After a few days, Nisha was happily surprised when she saw Beenu wearing one of the dresses beautifully refurbished. On enquiry, Beenu told Nisha that this was done by her daughter who had just completed her Class 12th studies. Beenu also told Nisha that she was a little concerned as her daughter did not want to study further. Nisha was very much impressed by the creativity of Beenu's daughter, so she decided to setup a small business for her. Nisha bought 15 sewing machines and appointed 15 girls to refurbish the old dresses. Nisha also arranged old dresses from various sources and employed a person who will sell these dresses at a very low cost for the one's who could not purchase news dresses due to their low income. Nisha divided the girls in three equal groups, each having five sewing machines. Each group was given a target of refurbishing 150 old dresses in a fortnight with a cost of Rs. 30 per dress. After a fortnight, Nisha who was supervising this business with Beenu was informed that Group I was able to meet the target by refurbishing 150 old dresses at a cost of Rs. 30 per dress. Group II was able to refurbish 150 old dresses at a cost of Rs. 35 per dress, whereas Group III could refurbish only 140 old dresses but at a cost of Rs. 27 per dress.
(i) Identify the concepts of management discussed above for each of the three groups giving reason in support of your answer.
(ii) Give meaning of the concepts identified in (i) above and state which one is important for the management and why?

sub_questions.text: अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में कारण देते हुए उपरोक्त तीनों समूहों में से प्रत्येक समूह में चर्चित प्रबन्ध की अवधारणाओं को पहचानिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the concepts of management discussed above for each of the three groups giving reason in support of your answer.

key_points: Group I — Effectiveness (achieved target of 150 dresses at Rs. 30)
Group II — Effectiveness but not Efficiency (target achieved but at higher cost Rs. 35)
Group III — Efficiency but not Effectiveness (lower cost Rs. 27 but target not met — only 140)

sub_questions.solution: Group I demonstrated both Effectiveness and Efficiency because it achieved the set target (150 dresses) within the specified cost (Rs. 30 per dress), completing the task as planned without any deviation. Group II demonstrated Effectiveness but not Efficiency because it met the target of 150 dresses but at a higher cost of Rs. 35 per dress instead of Rs. 30, meaning it achieved the goal but used more resources than planned — hence efficient use of resources was lacking. Group III demonstrated Efficiency but not Effectiveness because it worked at a lower cost of Rs. 27 per dress (below the budgeted amount), showing resource economy, but it could not complete the target of 150 dresses (only 140 were done), meaning the goal was not accomplished — hence it was not effective.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में पहचानी गई अवधारणाओं का अर्थ दीजिए और उल्लेख कीजिए कि कौन सी अवधारणा प्रबन्ध के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है और क्यों?
sub_questions.text_english: Give meaning of the concepts identified in (i) above and state which one is important for the management and why?

key_points: Effectiveness — achieving goals
Efficiency — achieving goals with minimum resources
Effectiveness is more important as goal achievement is primary

sub_questions.solution: Effectiveness means doing the right things — completing the assigned tasks and achieving the predetermined goals. It focuses on the output achieved regardless of the resources used. Efficiency means doing things in the right manner — achieving the goals using the minimum possible resources (time, cost, effort) so that wastage is reduced and productivity is maximized. It focuses on the relationship between inputs and outputs. Between the two, Effectiveness is considered more important for management. This is because if the goals themselves are not achieved, efficient use of resources has no value. For instance, a company may be very efficient in production but if it is not producing what the market needs (not effective), the business will fail. However, ideal management strives for both — achieving goals with minimum resource wastage.

questions.text: प्राची, विशेष योग्यता वाले विद्यार्थियों को सहायता एवं मार्गदर्शन देने के लिए एक प्रतिष्ठित विद्यालय में शैक्षणिक परामर्शदाता के रूप में कार्य कर रही है। उसने पहले से ही स्पष्ट रूप से पढ़ाने की विधियों एवं विद्यार्थियों की समस्याओं को सुलझाने के तरीकों को उल्लिखित कर दिया है। वह यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि प्रत्येक अध्यापक के लक्ष्यों का स्पष्ट रूप से उल्लेख किया जाए ताकि क्या कार्य किया जाना है और किस दिशा में किया जाना है के लिए वह एक मार्गदर्शक के रूप में कार्य करें। उसके द्वारा अच्छी तरह से बनाई गई योजनाएँ इन विद्यार्थियों को पढ़ाए जाने वाले विभिन्न विषयों के अध्यापकों के कार्यों व प्रयासों में समन्वय के लिए एक आधार प्रदान करेंगी। यह अध्यापकों को उनके कार्य के लिए विचारण एवं कार्य की स्पष्टता लाने में सहायता करती है। उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद में प्रबन्ध के नियोजन कार्य के महत्व के जिन दो बिन्दुओं पर प्रकाश डाला गया है उन्हें पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english: Prachi is working as an academic counsellor for specially abled students at one of the top school to provide special support and guidance to these students. She clearly states in advance the methods of teaching and tackling the students. She ensures that the goals are clearly stated for each and every teacher so that they act as a guide for deciding what action should be taken and in which direction. Her well laid plans will serve as a basis for coordinating the activities and efforts of teachers teaching different subjects to these students. It helps the teachers in bringing clarity of thought and action to their work. Identify and explain the two points of importance of 'Planning' function of management highlighted in the above para.

key_points: Planning provides direction
Planning facilitates co-ordination
Planning reduces overlapping and wasteful activities (clarity of thought)

questions.solution: The two points of importance of the Planning function highlighted in the paragraph are as follows. The first point is that Planning provides direction. The paragraph states that Prachi clearly sets out teaching methods and goals for each teacher so that they know what action to take and in which direction. This shows that planning gives a clear sense of direction to all members of an organization. When goals are clearly stated in advance, everyone understands what they must do and works in a coordinated manner towards the common objective. Without direction, efforts may be scattered and ineffective. The second point is that Planning facilitates co-ordination. The paragraph mentions that Prachi's well-laid plans serve as a basis for coordinating the activities and efforts of all teachers teaching different subjects to the specially-abled students. Planning integrates diverse activities and ensures that all departments or individuals work in harmony toward the same goal. It creates a common framework within which different teams can synchronize their work, thereby reducing duplication of effort and improving overall effectiveness.

जिम (व्यायामशाला) जाना और प्रोटीन आहार को लेना आजकल एक लोकप्रिय प्रवृत्ति बन गई है। लेकिन, व्यस्त कार्यशैली के कारण, बहुत से लोग, विशेषकर युवा, वज़न कम करने वाले कार्यक्रमों के लिए समय निकालने के लिए संघर्ष कर रहे हैं। अनिका एक बहुराष्ट्रीय कम्पनी में कार्यरत थी और वज़न कम करने के लिए जिम जाना चाहती थी, लेकिन समय नहीं निकाल सकती थी। उसके घर के पास कोई अच्छा जिम नहीं था। एक दिन जब दोपहर के भोजन के समय वह अपने कार्यालय के बाहर घूम रही थी उसने एक जिम का एक आकर्षक पोस्टर देखा जो उसके घर के पास था। अनिका उनके वज़न घटाने वाले कार्यक्रम के बारे में पूछताछ के लिए उत्सुक थी। अगले दिन, जब वह जिम गई तो जिम द्वारा दी जाने वाली विभिन्न योजनाओं के बारे में जानकर आश्चर्यचकित हो गई। वे वज़न घटाने वाले कार्यक्रमों पर न केवल 50% छूट दे रहे थे अपितु ग्राहकों को मुफ्त प्रशिक्षक सुविधा तथा मुफ्त प्रोटीन आहार भी दे रहे थे। लेकिन ये प्रस्ताव केवल 10 दिन तक वैध थे। इन योजनाओं से आकर्षित होकर अनिका ने तुरंत फीस जमा करा दी और जिम ज्वाइन कर लिया।

sub_questions.text_english: Identify and give the meaning of the element of marketing-mix discussed above.

key_points: Promotion
Promotion means communicating product/service information to target customers to stimulate purchase

sub_questions.solution: The element of marketing-mix discussed in the above case is Promotion. The demand for take away food business is increasing day-by-day. People working in multi-national companies have to work till night very often and they are reluctant to cook food. Taking advantage of this opportunity, Amit and Bijoy started 'Langar', a take away food business. The food became famous because of its good quality and standards of hygiene followed by them. Over the years, the business became very profitable. They decided to expand the business by opening more branches in different cities. To ensure consistent food quality at all branches and to maintain the hygiene and quality they planned to import machines with advanced technology. The cost of each machine was Rs. 12 crores. They knew that this decision has to be taken very carefully, as it involves a huge cost and that the decision, once taken is irreversible.
(i) Identify and state the financial decision discussed in the above para.
(ii) Explain any two factors affecting the decision identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद में चर्चित वित्तीय निर्णय को पहचानिए एवं उसका उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and state the financial decision discussed in the above para.

key_points: Investment Decision / Capital Budgeting Decision

sub_questions.solution: The financial decision discussed in the above paragraph is the Investment Decision, also called the Capital Budgeting Decision. It involves decisions related to investment of funds in long-term assets that will generate returns over a number of years. In this case, Amit and Bijoy decided to invest in high-technology machines worth Rs. 12 crores each for their expanding business. Since this involves a huge amount of funds, a long-term commitment, and is irreversible once taken, it is a classic example of an investment or capital budgeting decision.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में लिए गए निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले किन्हीं दो घटकों को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any two factors affecting the decision identified in (i) above.

key_points: Cash flows of the project
Rate of return / expected return

sub_questions.solution: Two factors affecting the Investment Decision are as follows. The first factor is Cash Flows of the Project. Before committing funds to a long-term asset, a business must carefully estimate the cash inflows and outflows associated with the project throughout its useful life. Amit and Bijoy must assess whether the revenues generated by using these high-technology machines will be sufficient to recover the Rs. 12 crore investment per machine and also generate profits. If expected cash flows are unfavourable, the investment should not be made. The second factor is the Expected Rate of Return. The management must evaluate whether the returns expected from the investment are adequate given the risk involved. Since the machines are costly and the decision is irreversible, Amit and Bijoy must ensure that the return on the investment is higher than the cost of capital and meets the profitability expectations of the business.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following steps in the process of selection: (i) Preliminary Screening, (ii) Selection Tests, (iii) Employment Interview, (iv) Reference and Background Checks

key_points: Preliminary Screening — eliminates clearly unsuitable candidates
Selection Tests — assess aptitude, intelligence, skills
Employment Interview — face-to-face evaluation
Reference and Background Checks — verify candidate's credentials

sub_questions.solution: The four steps in the process of selection are as follows. First, Preliminary Screening is the initial step in which clearly unsuitable applications are eliminated. The HR department reviews application forms and CVs to check whether applicants meet the basic minimum qualifications and requirements mentioned in the job advertisement. This saves the organization's time and resources by avoiding interviews of unqualified candidates. Second, Selection Tests are used to objectively assess the candidates who pass the preliminary screening. These tests may include intelligence tests (to assess reasoning and mental ability), aptitude tests (to measure potential to learn a job), personality tests (to evaluate traits and character), and proficiency tests (to check existing skills). These tests help compare candidates on standardized parameters. Third, Employment Interview is a face-to-face conversation between the interviewer and the candidate. It serves to gather deeper information about the candidate's knowledge, experience, personality, communication skills, and suitability for the job. It also allows the candidate to learn more about the organization and the job role. Interviews may be structured, unstructured, or situational. Fourth, Reference and Background Checks involve verifying the information provided by the candidate. The organization contacts previous employers, academic institutions, or character referees to confirm the candidate's qualifications, work history, conduct, and overall credibility, thereby reducing the risk of hiring a dishonest or unsuitable employee.

sub_questions.text: निम्नलिखित गैर-वित्तीय प्रोत्साहनों को समझाइए: (i) पद-प्रतिष्ठा, (ii) संगठनिक वातावरण, (iii) पद संवर्धन, (iv) कर्मचारियों की भागीदारी
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following non-financial incentives: (i) Status, (ii) Organisational climate, (iii) Job Enrichment, (iv) Employee participation

key_points: Status — position and prestige within the organization
Organisational climate — work atmosphere and culture
Job Enrichment — adding challenging and meaningful tasks
Employee participation — involving employees in decision-making

sub_questions.solution: The four non-financial incentives are explained as follows. First, Status refers to the rank, position, and prestige that an employee holds within the organization. Employees are often motivated by status symbols such as a corner office, a private secretary, a senior designation, or the authority to make decisions. When employees are given a higher status that is recognized by colleagues and management, it fulfils their esteem needs and motivates them to work harder. Second, Organisational Climate refers to the overall work atmosphere, culture, and environment that prevails in an organization. A positive organizational climate characterized by trust, openness, transparency, mutual respect, and supportive management motivates employees to perform at their best. Conversely, a toxic or rigid environment can reduce morale and productivity even if monetary rewards are generous. Third, Job Enrichment involves adding more meaningful, challenging, and responsible tasks to an employee's job to make it more interesting and satisfying. It is based on the idea that employees are motivated when they feel their work is purposeful and gives them opportunities to use and develop their skills. For example, giving an employee additional authority to plan their own work schedule makes the job enriching. Fourth, Employee Participation means involving employees in decision-making processes, especially those that directly affect their work. When employees are consulted and their opinions are valued, they feel important and respected, which increases their commitment and motivation. This also leads to better-quality decisions as those who perform the work often have the best insights into it.

questions.text:
आशा अचार, मुरब्बे तथा पापड़ इत्यादि बनाने एवं बेचने का व्यवसाय चला रही थी। पिछले कुछ वर्षों से वह अच्छा लाभ अर्जित कर रही थी। अब वह अपनी उत्पाद-पंक्ति में कुछ नए उत्पाद जोड़ना चाहती थी। मिलेट्स (मोटे अनाजों) की बढ़ती हुई माँग को देखते हुए उसने कुछ मिलेट उत्पादों को जोड़ने का निर्णय लिया। बहुत अधिक बाज़ार शोध करने के बाद, उसने पाया कि मिलेट्स नूडल्स, पास्ता तथा खाने के लिए तैयार मिलेट अनाजों की माँग दिन प्रति-दिन बढ़ रही थी। एक अलग स्वाद देने तथा अपने उत्पादों में विशिष्टता लाने के लिए उसने इन उत्पादों को पकाने के लिए एक नई जड़ी-बूटी आधारित स्वादिष्ट सॉस तैयार की और अपने मिलेट उत्पादों के साथ इसको बाज़ार में उतारने का निर्णय लिया। इसके लिए आशा ने 10 अतिरिक्त महिला कर्मचारियों को काम पर नियुक्त किया जो विशेष रूप से इसी के लिए प्रशिक्षित थीं। परंतु अतिरिक्त अधिक कामगारों को रखने के बाद भी वह आश्चर्य में थी कि उत्पादन अपेक्षा के अनुसार नहीं था। इस बारे में चिन्तित तथा यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि गतिविधियों का संचालन योजना अनुसार तथा पूर्व निश्चित लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति के लिए संसाधनों का उपयोग कुशलतापूर्वक एवं प्रभावपूर्ण ढंग से हो रहा था, आशा ने एक पर्यवेक्षक, निबिता को नियुक्त किया। निबिता ने गतिविधियों पर नज़र रखी और पता लगाया कि नए नियुक्त किए गए कामगारों में से दो पूरा दिन गप-शप करने और अन्य कामगारों का ध्यान भंग करने में अपना समय बिताती थीं। परिणामस्वरूप उत्पादन कम होता था।
(i) उपरोक्त चर्चित प्रबन्ध के कार्य को पहचानिए एवं उसका उल्लेख कीजिए।
(ii) उपरोक्त (i) में पहचाने गए कार्य के महत्व के किन्हीं पाँच बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Asha was running a business of producing and selling pickles, murabbas and papad etc. She was earning a good profit for the last many years. Now, she wanted to add some new products in her product line. Seeing the growing demand of millets, she decided to add some millet products. After doing a lot of market research, she found out that the demand for millet noodles, pasta and ready to eat millet cereals was increasing day-by-day. To give a different taste and to have uniqueness in her products, she prepared a new tasty herb based sauce for cooking these products and decided to launch this along with millet products in the market. For this Asha hired 10 additional women workers specially trained for the same. However, despite adding more workers, to her surprise, production was not upto the mark. Concerned about this and to ensure that the activities were performed as per the plans, and that the resources were being used effectively and efficiently for the achievement of predetermined goals, Asha appointed a supervisor Nabita. Nabita monitored the activities and discovered that two of the newly hired workers were spending their whole day gossiping and distracting the other workers. As a result the production was low.
(i) Identify and state the function of management discussed above.
(ii) State any five points of importance of the function identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त चर्चित प्रबन्ध के कार्य को पहचानिए एवं उसका उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and state the function of management discussed above.

key_points: Controlling

sub_questions.solution: The function of management discussed in the above case is Controlling. Controlling is the process of ensuring that activities in an organization are performed as per the plans and that the resources are being used effectively and efficiently to achieve predetermined goals. Asha appointed Nabita as a supervisor to monitor the activities of the newly hired workers and identify deviations from the expected performance. When Nabita discovered that two workers were wasting time gossiping and causing distractions, this was the corrective action stage of controlling — identifying the deviation (low production) and locating the cause (unproductive workers).

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में पहचाने गए कार्य के महत्व के किन्हीं पाँच बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any five points of importance of the function identified in (i) above.

key_points: Accomplishing organizational goals
Judging accuracy of standards
Making efficient use of resources
Improving employee motivation
Ensuring order and discipline

sub_questions.solution: The five points of importance of Controlling are as follows. First, Controlling helps in accomplishing organizational goals by ensuring that all activities are performed in accordance with the plans. It continuously monitors whether the organization is moving toward its predetermined objectives and takes corrective action wherever deviations occur. Second, Controlling helps in judging accuracy of standards. Over time, the process of controlling reveals whether the performance standards set were realistic and achievable. If actual performance consistently falls short despite efforts, the standards themselves may need to be revised. Third, Controlling makes efficient use of resources. By monitoring activities and identifying wastage, duplication of effort, or unproductive behaviour (as in Asha's case where workers were gossiping), controlling ensures that human, physical, and financial resources are utilized optimally. Fourth, Controlling improves employee motivation. When employees know that their performance is being regularly monitored and evaluated, it creates a sense of accountability and encourages them to stay focused and perform their best. Fifth, Controlling ensures order and discipline. By detecting and correcting deviations in behaviour and performance, controlling instils a sense of discipline in employees, as they understand that accountability exists and that deviations will not go unnoticed.

sub_questions.text: औपचारिक संगठन के किन्हीं तीन लाभों एवं किन्हीं तीन सीमाओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any three advantages and any three limitations of formal organization.

key_points: Advantages: clarity of authority, stability, systematic work
Limitations: rigid, slow communication, ignores social needs

sub_questions.solution: Formal organization has several advantages. First, it creates a clear chain of authority and responsibility, so every employee knows exactly who they are accountable to and what their duties are, reducing confusion. Second, it ensures stability and consistency in operations because work is carried out according to defined rules, procedures, and structures that remain uniform regardless of personnel changes. Third, it facilitates unity of command — each person receives orders from only one superior, which prevents conflicting instructions and brings discipline to the organization. However, formal organization also has limitations. First, it tends to be rigid and inflexible, making it difficult for organizations to adapt quickly to changes in the environment because all actions must follow prescribed procedures. Second, communication in a formal organization must pass through the official chain of command, which makes it slow and sometimes distorted by the time it reaches the intended recipient. Third, formal organization focuses only on the tasks, roles, and structures while ignoring the social and emotional needs of employees, which can lower morale and reduce informal cooperation and creativity.

sub_questions.text: संगठन के कार्यात्मक ढाँचे के किन्हीं छः लाभों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any six advantages of functional structure of organization.

key_points: Specialization and expertise
Efficient use of resources
Easy supervision
Promotes training
Coordination within department
Suitable for large organizations

sub_questions.solution: The functional structure of organization has the following six advantages. First, it leads to specialization and expertise because employees in each functional department — such as production, marketing, finance, and HR — focus exclusively on their area, developing deep skills and knowledge over time. Second, it facilitates efficient use of resources since specialists are grouped together and equipment, tools, and facilities are not duplicated across the organization, leading to economies of scale. Third, it enables easy supervision because managers in each department have expert knowledge of the work being done by their subordinates, allowing for more meaningful oversight and guidance. Fourth, it promotes training and development as a functional structure allows newcomers to learn from experienced specialists within their own department, facilitating systematic skill development. Fifth, it ensures better coordination within each department because all employees in a function share the same goals and work under the same head, making it easier to align efforts and resolve conflicts. Sixth, it is suitable for large organizations with complex and varied activities because it allows each major function to be managed by a dedicated team under a specialist head, ensuring focused and competent management of every area.

questions.text: बढ़ती हुई माँग को देखते हुए रवि तथा मेघा ने ऊर्जा कुशल एलईडी लाइटें उत्पादित करने के लिए 'एनर्जीलाइट्स' कम्पनी आरंभ की। उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली एलईडी लाइटों का कुछ अद्वितीय विशेषताओं के साथ उत्पादन करने के लिए तकनीक में भारी निवेश तथा उच्चश्रेणी की सामग्री की आवश्यकता थी। इससे उनकी उत्पादन लागत बढ़ गई। अपनी एलईडी लाइटों के मूल्य का निर्धारण करने के लिए वे न केवल सभी लागतों को पूरा करना चाहते थे अपितु लागत के ऊपर एक लाभ-मार्जिन भी अर्जित करना चाहते थे। यह उनके लिए वह न्यूनतम स्तर या आधार मूल्य निर्धारित करेगा जिस पर एलईडी लाइटों की बिक्री की जाएगी। ऊँची माँग तथा इन लाइटों द्वारा प्रदान की गई उपयोगिता मूल्य के ऊपर के स्तर का निर्धारण करेगी। यद्यपि एलईडी लाइटों के व्यवसाय में काफी प्रतिस्पर्धा थी तब भी इनकी अच्छी गुणवत्ता तथा विशेषताओं के कारण उन्होंने अपनी एलईडी लाइटों का मूल्य प्रतिस्पर्धियों के मूल्यों से अधिक रखा। इन्होंने उत्पाद विशिष्टीकरण तथा विज्ञापन एवं विक्रय संवर्धन आदि की अद्वितीय विधियों के कारण अपने ऊँचे मूल्यों का औचित्य दिया। उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियाँ उद्धृत करते हुए ऐसे किन्हीं तीन कारकों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए जिन्हें एलईडी लाइटों का मूल्य-निर्धारण करते समय रवि तथा मेघा ने ध्यान में रखा।
questions.text_english: Ravi and Megha started 'Energylights' a company manufacturing energy-efficient LED lighting after realizing an increasing demand for the same. Manufacturing high-quality LED lights with some unique features required substantial investment in technology and high-grade materials. This pushed up their cost of manufacturing. To determine the price of their LED lights they not only wanted to cover all costs but also wanted to earn a margin of profit over and above the costs. This will set for them the minimum level or the floor price at which the LED lights would be sold. The high demand and the utility provided by these lights will set the upper limit of the price. Though there was enough competition in LED lights business, even then they kept the price of their lights higher than the competitors because of good quality and its features. They justified the higher price because of the product differentiation and unique methods of advertising and sales promotion etc. Quoting lines from the above para, identify and explain any three factors which were taken into consideration by Ravi and Megha to determine the price of their LED lights.

key_points: Cost of Production — floor price
Demand and Utility — upper limit of price
Competition — priced higher due to quality and differentiation

questions.solution: Three factors considered by Ravi and Megha while determining the price of their LED lights are as follows. The first factor is Cost of Production. The paragraph states: 'they not only wanted to cover all costs but also wanted to earn a margin of profit over and above the costs. This will set for them the minimum level or the floor price at which the LED lights would be sold.' This shows that the cost of manufacturing (including investment in technology and high-grade materials) formed the floor price — the minimum price below which the product cannot be sold without incurring a loss. Thus, cost is a critical determinant of pricing. The second factor is Demand and Utility. The paragraph states: 'The high demand and the utility provided by these lights will set the upper limit of the price.' This indicates that the level of demand for the product and the utility or value it provides to customers determines the ceiling price — the maximum a customer is willing to pay. High demand and high utility justify a higher selling price and allow the company to price above costs. The third factor is Competition. The paragraph states: 'Though there was enough competition in LED lights business, even then they kept the price of their lights higher than the competitors because of good quality and its features.' This shows that while competition normally pressures businesses to align prices with competitors, the product differentiation achieved through quality, unique features, and promotional methods allowed Ravi and Megha to justify a premium pricing strategy despite competitive pressures.
questions.solution_hindi: तीन कारक: (1) उत्पादन लागत — न्यूनतम मूल्य स्तर; (2) माँग और उपयोगिता — अधिकतम मूल्य सीमा; (3) प्रतिस्पर्धा — गुणवत्ता के कारण प्रतिस्पर्धियों से अधिक मूल्य रखा गया।
